Jordan / team — looked through the numbers in Athena_PO_Prices_v3.xlsx and ran several waterfall scenarios. Summary recommendation below; detailed tab in the spreadsheet (attached) has per-SKU net after passback for both anchors.

Recommended headroom & passback model (preferred):
- List price anchoring: keep SKU list prices at current catalog to support reseller margins and marketplace visibility.
- Reseller passback: gross-basis 15% for first $300k attainment, steps up to 18% between $300k–$1.5M, 20% > $1.5M (this is applied to list price).
- Distributor commission: 5% flat (handled off-invoice between reseller and distributor).
- Redwood net after-passback: target ~62–70% of list depending on tier.

Why this structure: gross-basis passback preserves reseller economics and is simple to show on marketplace POs. Stepped rates incentivize attainment while keeping net economics predictable for Athena.

SKU mapping notes:
- Starter pack -> map to 'sku.basic' (metered embedding units) and 'sku.kv-cache' (flat monthly)
- Enterprise pack -> higher-rate 'sku.pro' + add-on 'sku.priority-routing'
- We need to ensure SKU list prices in the attachment match the Azure marketplace SKU IDs (Karhtik/Irene, please confirm mapping).

Next steps:
1) Karhtik/Irene: confirm SKU IDs and whether Azure private offers allow gross-basis passback representation (some marketplaces only show net pricing on the buyer invoice).
2) Jordan: share preferred commit tiers (Athena draft had $300k / $1.5M).
